title: Taylor Shellfish family screening (Sept 2025)
temperature_profile: Warmed from 22 to 35 C over 2.5 h (measured on day 1); temperature_c records the 35 C plateau
description: 38 Taylor Shellfish hatchery families screened on 2025-09-03 (38 plates); plates 1-19 were re-run with the same oysters on 2025-09-04 as a repeat stressor. Reads at 0.5, 1.5 and 2.5 h; there was no hour-0 read, so hour 0 is each plate's mean blank fluorescence, as in the source analysis. Wells the source analysis drops (not exactly one oyster, saturated, inactive) are flagged as excluded.
